knowledge:
- key_parameters: exprdata=A matrix or data frame containing gene expression data with genes as rows (gene IDs as rownames) and samples as columns (sample IDs as colnames) ;; se=A SummarizedExperiment object containing gene expression data in assays (named "FPKM" or "counts") ;; tissue=A string indicating the tissue of origin (e.g., "brain", "blood", "liver"). If omitted or not in the supported list, an across-tissue predictor is used ;; exprtype=Either "counts" or "FPKM". If "counts", data is automatically converted to FPKM ;; idtype=Gene ID type in exprdata ("SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL", "ENTREZID", "REFSEQ"). Default is "SYMBOL" ;; stype=Calculator version to use: "all" (all races) or "Caucasian" (Caucasian only) ;; signature=The age signature to use ("DESeq2", "Pearson", "Dev", "deMagalhaes", "GenAge", "GTExAge", "Peters", "all") ;; genelength=Optional vector of gene lengths in bp, used only when exprtype="counts" ;; chronage=Optional data frame with sample ID in the 1st column and chronological age in the 2nd column, used to calculate age acceleration residuals
- alternatives: Microarray-based transcriptional age predictors, which the documentation notes are typically limited to only a few tissues compared to this RNASeq-based multi-tissue calculator
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have human RNA-seq data (raw counts or FPKM) from specific tissues or across tissues and want to estimate biological/transcriptional age and calculate age acceleration residuals
- pitfalls: Age acceleration residuals will not be calculated if the chronological age is not provided or if the sample size with available chronological age is 30 or fewer ;; The genelength argument is ignored if exprtype is set to "FPKM" ;; When using predict_age_fromse, the chronological age column in colData(se) must be named exactly "age", and the gene length column in rowData(se) must be named exactly "bp_length"

workflows.name: predict_age_dataframe
workflows.intent: Calculate transcriptional age and age acceleration residuals from a gene expression data frame or matrix and visualize the results.
input: fpkm (matrix or data frame of FPKM or raw counts with gene IDs as rownames)
chronage (data frame containing sample IDs and chronological ages)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the package and expression data. 2. Define chronological age data frame. 3. Predict age using predict_age. 4. Visualize results using makeplot.
workflows.code:
library(RNAAgeCalc)
data(fpkmExample)
head(fpkm)
chronage = data.frame(sampleid = colnames(fpkm), age = c(30,50))
res = predict_age(exprdata = fpkm, tissue = "brain", exprtype = "FPKM", 
                  chronage = chronage)
head(res)
fpkm_large = cbind(fpkm, fpkm+1, fpkm+2, fpkm+3)   
fpkm_large = cbind(fpkm_large, fpkm_large, fpkm_large, fpkm_large)
colnames(fpkm_large) = paste0("sample",1:32)
chronage2 = data.frame(sampleid = colnames(fpkm_large), age = 31:62)
res2 = predict_age(exprdata = fpkm_large, exprtype = "FPKM",
                  chronage = chronage2)
head(res2)
makeplot(res2)

workflows.name: predict_age_summarized_experiment
workflows.intent: Calculate transcriptional age from a SummarizedExperiment object.
input: se (SummarizedExperiment object containing expression data in assays and chronological age in colData)
workflows.stages: 1. Load SummarizedExperiment and package. 2. Construct or load SummarizedExperiment with "FPKM" or "counts" assay and "age" column in colData. 3. Predict age using predict_age_fromse.
workflows.code:
library(SummarizedExperiment)
colData = data.frame(age = c(40, 50))
se = SummarizedExperiment(assays=list(FPKM=fpkm), colData=colData)
res3 = predict_age_fromse(se = se, exprtype = "FPKM")
head(res3)
